blindness.mechanism: code-level guard: assert_no_outcome() on every frame, and the outcome sidecar is never opened by this module
blindness.is_not_a_privilege_boundary: a real boundary would be a database role that cannot SELECT the outcome schema, so a mistake fails at the connection rather than at a check someone can delete. DuckDB single-file has no GRANT/DENY, so this weaker guarantee is recorded rather than glossed over.

maturity.rule: the tenth forward TRADING session after entry has elapsed AND the bars for the horizon are present AND no blocking DQ failure
maturity.incomplete: MATURITY_DATA_INCOMPLETE — does not count toward the lock

lock_counter: mature forward T5 episodes; not signals, not calendar days, not valid memberships

support_eligibility.no_replacement: no replacement medoid, no threshold lowering, no family refill

invariants.no_outcome_field_reachable: enforced by assert_no_outcome on every frame
invariants.mature_count_monotone: checked against the previous ledger row on every append
invariants.membership_immutable_after_insert: a changed pipeline is a new data_version, never a rewrite

lock_manifest_rule: when mature == 20,000, the FIRST 20,000 mature episodes are frozen into the manifest with a lock hash; episode 20,001 onward is not in the validation run
